sealed_statement.local_relation: For C=K2 with base lists [4], mu_C(F)=1 iff |F|<=2. Restricting dynamic complete-neighbor colors to {1,2,3}, this forbids exactly the rainbow event F={1,2,3}.
sealed_statement.direct_embedding_obstruction: A literal one-variable-survivor / one-K2-per-3-uniform-hyperedge / stable-variable encoding of arbitrary no-rainbow hypergraph incidence cannot remain P7-free.
sealed_statement.witness: For e1={v1,v2,a}, e2={v2,v3,b}, e3={v3,v4,c}, choosing one vertex q_i from each K2 component yields induced path x_v1-q1-x_v2-q2-x_v3-q3-x_v4.
sealed_statement.consequence: P7-freeness itself forbids arbitrary alternating survivor-component incidence chains of length 7 in the direct semantic encoding.

hardness_firewall.warning: The theorem seal blocks only the direct incidence-preserving embedding; it does not rule out a more elaborate source-valid hardness embedding with additional semantically exact gadgets.
